convention_hypothesis: rejected for this scan: every gold line sits 4.8-5.9 mm from the outer apex on the concave side. The outer virtual sharp is on the opposite side (6.0-6.9 mm away). The gold lies 3.5-4.35 mm beyond the inner skin (t about 1.27 mm), 4.9-5.0 mm from the inner virtual sharp (HB1/HB3/HB4, well sampled) and 2.8-3.9 mm from the arc centre. It is a systematic, near-constant bias, not a locus convention. No rigid or similarity transform removes it. An affine does (RMS 0.7 mm), but only with a +24% Z / +2-3% XY stretch about the tray centre, which is not a plausible frame error.
